other.content: Label from original backing in object file, typed: ARTIST GEORGIA O'KEEFFE NO. 8 / TITLE RED AND GREEN IV DATE 1916 / MEDIUME WATERCOLOR SIZE 9x12 S.P. / THE DOWNTOWN GALLERY 32 E. 51st St., New York (Source: MAM, 2025)

materials.content: Watercolor on moderately thick, white, slightly textured wove paper (Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance:
[1] By February 25, 1958, (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA); [2] April 8, 1958, purchased by Mrs. Edward R. (Ethel E.) Wehr [1885–1961] (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); [2] October 21, 1958, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1] The Downtown Gallery, Georgia O’Keeffe: Watercolors, 1916–17 (New York: The Downtown Gallery, 1958), cat. 8. 
[2] Invoice addressed to Mrs. Edward R. Wehr in MAM object file, with canceled check dated July 12, 1958. Date of purchase by Wehr is listed as August 29, 1958 in Verna Posever Curtis, Georgia O’Keeffe (Milwaukee: Milwaukee Art Center, 1977), p. 13, but source of that information is unknown. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 67, cat. 87. 
[3] MAM catalogue card 
 (Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "No. 8" in 1958 New York (Downtown) exhibition. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, April 1958." Completed in New York or Virginia before August move to Texas. See cat. no. 85. Milwaukee Art Museum indicates that this work was in its current condition prior to their accession of it. See cat. no. 85. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
